issues.description: MATLAB and the source-used toolbox/functions could not be verified in the target environment: the MATLAB executable did not resolve on PATH and no license/toolbox probe was possible.
The supplied inventory has no definitions for README-required cluster_se.m and cluster_wildboot.m, which active simulation source calls. The current closure of these helpers is unresolved.
FRQSim_EstAR actively calls FRQlag for its own lag construction; no FRQlag definition is supplied among the package's MATLAB sources. Do not assume FRQLagGroupMean is an alias.
README-listed NumToLatex.m is absent from the supplied inventory, while FRQSim_MBB_Power calls NumToLatex to format results.

README's ordered workflow requires FRQSim_FinalStats.m for most main-paper and supplement summaries, but the file is not supplied. FRQSim_FinalStats_Gauss.m is a separate Gaussian-critical-value summary and does not replace this stage.

The documented workflow says directory references must be modified; source scripts contain fixed Windows directory literals. A consistent package root and working-directory setup must be selected across producing and consuming stages.

MBB1–4 save each simulation MAT under Results/Pt1–Pt4, but the four wrap-up scripts load the same basename from the current directory. The packaged result MATs are at the archive root. The run handoff path must be reconciled consistently, and output folders may need creation.

FRQSim_Main writes FRQSim_FINAL_PART1 in its current directory, while FRQSim_MBB_Power reads it under Results/Chris; MBB_Power also reads Pt2–Pt4 beneath Results/PtN although the supplied final MATs are at the archive root. Full-pipeline and packaged-result analysis routes need distinct coherent path choices.

evidence.description: README specifies the ordered calibration and simulation stages and identifies the absent FRQSim_FinalStats.m stage.
evidence.quote:
1.  FRQFitModel.m                  - main .m file for fitting spatio-temporal model to Balakrishnan et al. (2014) data
2.  FRQFitMean.m                   - get OLS estimates of regression coefficients, fixed effects, and parameters on functions of lagged errors
3.  FRQSim_GenY.m                  - file that generates simulated Y values
4.  FRQSim_EstAR.m                 - estimate ad hoc "autoregressive" models in simulated data for use in ad hoc adaptive procedure
5.  FRQSim_Main.m                  - obtain most simulation results
6.  FRQSim_FinalStats.m            - calculate most summaries of simulation results reported in paper and supplement, includes all calculation of Canay-Romano-Shaikh with two year time block groups
7.  FRQSim_WildBoot.m              - obtain wild bootstrap critical values

evidence.description: README lists custom inference helpers, including cluster_se.m and cluster_wildboot.m.
evidence.quote:
Dependent data inference files:
cluster_se.m		- calculate clustered standard errors
FamaMacbeth.m		- perform Fama-MacBeth estimation
FamaMacbethRand.m	- Canay-Romano-Shaikh permutation inference
cluster_wildboot.m	- wild bootstrap with Mammen weights critical values
index_mbb.m		- generate indices for blocks to use in panel overlapping block bootstrap

review_notes: The static audit has zero supported dependency edges because MATLAB is unsupported by its parser; this is not an absence-of-code finding. All 34 supplied MATLAB files were inspected.

FRQMainMat.csv is the author-prepared baseline empirical input. A bounded one-row probe verifies readability and all 66 code-looked-up header names; this does not certify full row coverage or numerical results.

In the full pipeline, FRQSim_FINAL_BOOT, FRQSim_FINAL_FIRMTIME, the four SizePt result MATs and FRQSim_FINAL_PART2_GAUSS are generated by earlier scoped simulation/summary stages. Their packaged copies are requirements only for the separate analysis-only post-processing route.

The analysis-only MBB power route is supported by source order: FRQSim_FinalStats_Gauss loads PART1 and saves all workspace variables to PART2_GAUSS; the packaged PART2_GAUSS header has b with shape 1000x9, and FRQSim_MBB_Power immediately keeps only b from its initial load. It still needs a path adjustment and the absent NumToLatex helper.

The supplied bcv_optim6.mat is an active FRQFitModel input; SigmaEsts.mat and distparams.mat are regenerated outputs. FRQFitMean creates the index/design/parameter MATs and FRQSim_GenY creates ySim files consumed by later stages.
No author code was executed, compiled or imported, and no MATLAB MAT values were loaded; MAT metadata probes used scipy.io.whosmat headers only.
